mission.posting: A client wants to be sent some information on a colleague's phone

email.subject: Smash N' Grab
email.body:
Agent,
This contract will require familiarity with eOS devices and their security - a client's looking for some information stored on a colleague's phone - a password, to be precise, and wants it extracted. They've provided the IP of the computer the device is sync'd to, as we requested.
It's linked to this email. You're looking for a password they use - if you find multiple respond with all of them if possible - the verification bot will try all of them.
Good luck, -Entropy Admins
